blocks.text: All of Greengold's tools live in a single command: **`gg`**. You do not need an external package manager, formatter or test library. From this lesson on you run the commands **in a terminal on your own computer** (they do not run in the browser editor). For a new project:
This sets up the standard folder layout:

code: └── main.gg     # the entry point with sample code

blocks.text: `gg.toml` holds the project's identity, its entry file and its dependencies:

After adding a dependency you can write `import math_utils.matrix` in a file of your project; this binds the name `matrix` in that file. `import math_utils.matrix as m` renames it and `import math_utils.matrix { mul }` takes a chosen name directly. Every file writes its own `import` lines; `fn main` exists only in the root file you compile.
